basis: Cerence’s May 7 earnings release forecast consolidated revenue of $52 million to $56 million for the fiscal quarter ending June 30, 2025. The $56 million high end was 20.61% below the prior-year quarter’s reported $70,539,000 and below the $67,012,050 cutoff. This was the earliest qualifying quarter-specific disclosure found.

coverage.detail: November 21, 2024. The initial FY2025 outlook gave $47 million to $50 million for the December quarter and $236 million to $247 million for the fiscal year. Neither range established a June-quarter ceiling.

February 6, 2025. The Q1 release forecast $74 million to $77 million for the quarter ending March 31, including $20 million of projected fixed-license revenue. It reaffirmed the annual outlook without specifying June-quarter revenue.

The February earnings presentation labels its GAAP revenue guidance columns Q2 2025 and FY2025. Subtracting first-half revenue from the annual outlook would leave Q3 and Q4 combined, without establishing a Q3 upper bound.

The issuer’s calendar lists the February 6 Q1 call and May 7 Q2 call consecutively. The search of public management remarks found no earlier June-quarter revenue ceiling. The subsequent investor conferences were May 29 and June 10.

The pre-May 7 issuer archive includes a March 20 board appointment, an April 16 earnings scheduling notice, product and partnership announcements, and a May 6 litigation announcement. The first June-quarter revenue range found was in the May 7 release.

May 7, 2025, Exhibit 99.1. Under the fiscal Q3 outlook, Cerence gave the June-quarter revenue range of $52 million to $56 million and separately stated its assumption that no material fixed-license contracts would be signed that quarter.
July 23, 2025. Cerence scheduled the August 6 results release without providing preliminary figures. The intervening disclosure search found no revised public Q3 revenue range.

August 6, 2025, Exhibit 99.2. The consolidated statements and GAAP revenue reconciliation both report $62,236,000 for the three months ended June 30, 2025 and $70,539,000 for the same three months in 2024. Actual revenue exceeded guidance and still fell 11.77% year over year.

publication_date_evidence: Cerence’s IR release states “Released May 7, 2025.” Its press-release archive timestamps publication at 4:05 p.m. EDT, before the 5:00 p.m. Eastern earnings call that day.
